name: Idemitsu Kosan Co.,Ltd.
summary: Idemitsu Kosan Co.,Ltd. engages in the fuel oil, basic chemicals, functional materials, power and renewable energy, and resources businesses in Japan, Singapore, Asia, Oceania, North America, and internationally. The Fuel Oil segment engages in the production, sale, import, export, and trading in petroleum refined products comprising sustainable aviation fuel, synthetic fuel, biofuels, and carbon offset fuel; and operation of service stations that provide refueling, car wash, vehicle inspection, and maintenance services.
